name: cashou
description: Application de jeu financier avec PostgreSQL, Prisma, Bun et Docker

scripts.dev:setup: bun install && docker compose up db_cashou db_backoffice -d && bun run db:generate && bun run migrate
scripts.dev: docker stop cashou-backend-1 cashou-backoffice-1 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose up db_cashou db_backoffice -d && concurrently "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:backoffice"
scripts.dev:all: docker stop cashou-backend-1 cashou-backoffice-1 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose up db_cashou db_backoffice -d && concurrently "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:backoffice" "bun run dev:mobile"
scripts.prod:setup: bun install && bun run docker:build && bun run docker:up && bun run db:generate && bun run migrate:deploy
scripts.prod:start: docker compose down && bun run docker:up
scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run build:backoffice
scripts.build:all: bun run build:backend && bun run build:backoffice && bun run build:mobile
scripts.db:generate: bun run db:generate:app && bun run db:generate:backoffice
scripts.migrate: cd packages/@cashou/db-app && bunx dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: cd packages/@cashou/db-app && bunx dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:reset: cd packages/@cashou/db-app && bunx dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:migrate:app: cd packages/@cashou/db-app && bunx dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:backoffice: cd packages/@cashou/db-backoffice && bunx dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:empty: cd packages/@cashou/db-app && bunx dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:check: cd packages/@cashou/db-app && bunx dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma db pull --force
scripts.studio: cd packages/@cashou/db-app && bunx dotenv -e ../../../.env -- prisma studio
scripts.docker:clean: docker compose down -v && docker system prune -f
scripts.setup: bun install && bun run docker:up && bun run generate && bun run migrate
scripts.setup:clean: bun install && bun run docker:up && bun run generate && bun run migrate && rm -rf node_modules/.cache
scripts.setup:cac40: bun run setup && bun run db:seed:cac40
scripts.reset: bun run docker:down && bun run docker:clean && bun run docker:up && bun run migrate:reset
scripts.install:all: bun install && cd backend && bun install && cd ../backoffice && bun install
scripts.setup:seeds: bun run install:all && bun run docker:up && bun run generate && bun run migrate && bun run db:seed

author: Cashou Team
